## **The Photo Looks Peaceful. Your Flat Doesn’t.**


We all love the look of calm and clarity. A bare floor. A simple sofa. One plant. Shelves with just 2 things on them.


Then you look around your own flat. The sewing machine your mom no longer uses. The trunk with your wedding sarees. The brass vessels from your last family function. The boxes of books you still need to read. An extra cot and mattress. A cupboard that no longer fits anywhere.


You keep all of these things for a reason. And you can’t just get rid of them. That’s where minimizing becomes a problem. Most methods promote “getting rid of everything,” and that’s when it usually backfires.


## **Clearing Out in a Rush Usually Backfires**


You feel great for a week for clearing everything out. Then things start to happen. You realize you regret getting rid of something, and now you wish you had it back.


A month later, you go and buy it. The sofa you donated in March comes back, at full price in October. There are things you can't put a price on. Some things you can't replace. You can't buy emotional attachment. You can't replace sentiment.


You give up. Halfway through a decluttering session, you become tired. The rest of the clutter creeps back. You stop and give up.


Instead, the idea is to decide what you want in your home, rather than what you want to get rid of. Everything else gets stored in **[household storage in Chennai](https://stownest.com/household-storage-chennai?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self+storage+chennai)** . Your home is instantly decluttered, and you haven't gotten rid of anything sentimental.


Some months later, you'll know for sure what you really need. You can finally part ways with the sentimental items you don't really need.

## **A Simple Way To Decide What Goes**


You don't need an elaborate system. Walk through your home and make three piles.


Pile 1: Items used either every day or week. This should be in your home.


Pile 2: Items used less frequently. This includes seasonal items and guest furniture.


Pile 3: Items that make you feel guilty or sentimental. This can also include gifts.


Storage helps you the most when you put away things from this pile, and decide their fate later.


## **What’s Worth Storing**


Depending on your situation most people store a combination of the following.


-


Seasonal and festival items


-


Furniture and bedding


-


Decorative items


-


Appliances


-


Sentimental and heirloom items


-


Home décor


You can also call customer support to help you decide regarding a particular item.


## **What It Costs**


We have different rates for the different items you store. Therefore, you only pay for what you store. If you are storing away just a few boxes and a couple of small pieces of furniture, you aren't paying for an entire unit. Call customer support with a basic list and your time frame, and they will provide you with a quote.


## **How Long Should You Store Things?**


There is no right answer to this question. Some customers use short term storage for a few months to see what they miss. Others use storage for years. **[Temporary storage](https://stownest.com/household-storage-chennai?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self+storage+chennai)** works the same way, so just let customer support know your time frame when you call and they will help you.


## **What Happens After A Few Months?**


This is the best part. You get used to your stuff being out of your house, and you start to forget about what you've stored away. After a while, you start to feel good about parting ways with things you don't miss. The things you do miss can be returned. Other things you aren't ready to make a decision about can stay, with no pressure.


## **Who This Suits in Chennai?**


This is ideal for people in small, compact apartments to help them ease the stress of a cluttered home, for people interested in trying minimalism to see how it feels to have less stuff, and for families to help store seasonal/festival items they don't need year round. This is also ideal for people who have previously decluttered and regretted getting rid of things.


## **A Calm Home Doesn't Need a Clear-Out**


Minimalism doesn't always mean loss. With self-storage in Chennai, you can keep what is important to you and take your time to decide on what is really worth keeping.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Yes. For items that you don’t use on a day to day basis, store them instead of getting rid of them. With self storage in Chennai, your items are kept safely while your home stays clutter free.


**2. How does self storage in Chennai aid in decluttering?**


It offers a safe place to store items that you are still not decided about. You can decide what to do with them after living with a clutter free home for a while.


**3. What can I keep in household storage in Chennai while going minimalist?**


You can store extra furniture, boxes of clothes and books, seasonal and festival items, and decor, as well as sentimental things that you haven’t decided what to do with.


**4. How do storage units in Chennai determine prices?**

Yes. Temporary storage in Chennai is fairly common, particularly to try minimalism.


**6. Can I keep some items in storage and get the rest?**


Yes. Items are tracked individually, and you can request specific items be returned whenever you want.
